assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a single high-resolution painted 2D fighting-game boss base sprite for Half-Life Resonance. Reference image is the original GLaDOS model screenshot from Portal (2007), not Portal 2. Recreate ONLY the suspended GLaDOS machine from that reference on a truly transparent background. Preserve the long vertical hanging mechanical chassis, original narrow angular black-and-white head with small yellow eye pointing downward-right, large dark rounded ribbed central components, white curved structural shells, thin dark suspending cables and the four spherical personality cores attached around the body, with their original individual colored eyes and dark circular mounting rims. Follow the source geometry closely; do not substitute the smoother Portal 2 head or body and do not turn GLaDOS into a humanoid or a generic robot. One intact machine assembly, one pose, clearly readable three-quarter side view facing right, entire machine within the canvas with breathing room. The upper hanging connector and cables terminate cleanly within the sprite. Detailed realistic raster game art with crisp contours, restrained shading, visible original material divisions and wear. Remove the room, ceiling truss, walls, monitors, all signage and all environmental objects from the reference. No extra character, no room, no floor, no separate shadow, no glow cloud, no text, no montage, no separate views, no borders. Preserve genuine alpha in all open gaps between cables and parts.
assets.qa_notes: No image returned. No retry attempted. Source screenshot was visually inspected; Portal 1 hanging chassis and attached personality cores.
